D1 Softball Batting Explorer

players = transpose(batting_raw)

viewof y_metric = Inputs.radio(
  new Map([
    ["On-Base Percentage (OBP)", "OBP"],
    ["Slugging Percentage (SLG)", "SLG"],
    ["Home Runs (HR)", "HR"],
    ["At Bats (AB)", "AB"]
  ]),
  { value: "OBP", label: "Y-Axis Metric:" }
)

viewof season_filter = Inputs.select(
  ["All", "2026", "2025"],
  { value: "All", label: "Season:" }
)

viewof min_pa = Inputs.range(
  [0, 200],
  { value: 50, step: 10, label: "Minimum PA:" }
)

filtered = players.filter(d =>
  (season_filter === "All" || d.Season === season_filter) &&
  d.PA >= min_pa
)

Showing player-seasons

y_labels = ({
  OBP: "On-Base Percentage (OBP)",
  SLG: "Slugging Percentage (SLG)",
  HR: "Home Runs (HR)",
  AB: "At Bats (AB)"
})

Plot.plot({
  width: 800,
  height: 520,
  grid: true,
  x: {
    label: "Batting Average (BA)",
    domain: [0.1, 0.55]
  },
  y: {
    label: y_labels[y_metric],
    nice: true
  },
  color: {
    legend: true,
    label: "Class"
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(filtered, {
      x: "BA",
      y: y_metric,
      stroke: "Class",
      fill: "Class",
      fillOpacity: 0.55,
      r: 3.5,
      tip: true,
      title: d => `${d.Player} (${d.Team}, ${d.Season})\nClass: ${d.Class} | POS: ${d.POS} | PA: ${d.PA} | AB: ${d.AB}\nBA: ${d.BA.toFixed(3)} | OBP: ${d.OBP.toFixed(3)} | SLG: ${d.SLG.toFixed(3)} | HR: ${d.HR}`
    })
  ]
})
